definitions.explanation: Oil extracted from sesame seeds, used for flavoring and cooking in Asian cuisine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕上|しあ}げ→仕上げ：11519_shiage⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{胡麻油|ごまあぶら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回|まわ}しかける→回しかける：28723_mawashikakeru⟧。
examples.english: Drizzle sesame oil over the dish as a finishing touch.
examples.notes: 回しかける describes drizzling in a circular motion

examples.japanese: {胡麻油|ごまあぶら}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{食欲|しょくよく}→食欲：03249_shokuyoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦そそる→そそる：10359_sosoru⟧。
examples.english: The aroma of sesame oil stimulates the appetite.

examples.japanese: ⟦{中華料理|ちゅうかりょうり}→中華料理：18122_chuukaryouri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{胡麻油|ごまあぶら}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{使|つか}われる→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Sesame oil is commonly used in Chinese cuisine.

notes:
{胡麻油|ごまあぶら} is oil extracted from sesame seeds, widely used in East Asian cooking. Also commonly written as ⟦ごま→胡麻：10337_goma⟧⟦{油|あぶら}→油：01693_abura⟧ or ⟦ゴマ→胡麻：10337_goma⟧⟦{油|あぶら}→油：01693_abura⟧.

TYPES:
- ⟦{焙煎|ばいせん}→焙煎：16935_baisen⟧⟦ごま→胡麻：10337_goma⟧⟦{油|あぶら}→油：01693_abura⟧: roasted sesame oil — dark brown, strong nutty aroma, used as a finishing flavoring
- ⟦{太白|たいはく}→太白：noentry⟧⟦ごま→胡麻：10337_goma⟧⟦{油|あぶら}→油：01693_abura⟧: unroasted sesame oil — light, mild, used for general cooking and frying

USAGE:
The roasted variety is most common in Japanese home cooking. It is typically drizzled over dishes at the end of cooking to preserve its aroma (⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧). A key seasoning in Chinese (⟦{中華料理|ちゅうかりょうり}→中華料理：18122_chuukaryouri⟧) and Korean (⟦{韓国料理|かんこくりょうり}→韓国料理：25590_kankokuryouri⟧) cuisine as well.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {胡麻油|ごまあぶら}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{炒|いた}める→炒める：01879_itameru⟧: to stir-fry in sesame oil
- {胡麻油|ごまあぶら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回|まわ}しかける→回しかける：28723_mawashikakeru⟧: to drizzle sesame oil (in a circular motion)
